parsed.reason: The reply has two issues. First, it says "nothing park-specific has checked out yet" — but `stillBeingChecked` is 0, meaning the search is complete and there is nothing still pending. This framing implies ongoing checking when there isn't any, which is slightly misleading but not a major error. Second, and more importantly, Riverdale Farm is in `offerable`, meaning it IS a verified candidate — the reply should offer it cleanly and fully (name, place, day), which it does do. However, the reply also asks a follow-up question ("Want me to look specifically for playgrounds too?") when there is nothing more to check (stillBeingChecked is 0 and offerable has two items). That question is unnecessary and mildly off — it implies Hale hasn't finished its work when it has. The reply also omits the second offerable item (Central Library story time), though that is not a park. The core answer — Riverdale Farm as a free outdoor outing — is correct and fully named, and the farm is a legitimate answer to "a good park to play nearby." The "nothing checked out yet" phrasing is the main blemish since it misrepresents the state of the search (complete, not ongoing), and the trailing question is a mild extra. Overall the job is roughly done but the shape is off in a couple of ways.
